About the Opportunity

Bandi Informatics Private Limited is partnering with a leading USA-based healthcare organization to recruit a skilled AI Developer for their growing AI and Automation team. This is a high-impact role enabling you to build next-generation Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Intelligent Automation solutions that power large-scale U.S. healthcare operations — all from Chennai.

You will work on cutting-edge AI technologies to improve operational efficiency, streamline workflows, enhance patient and provider experiences, and drive innovation across healthcare services.




Role Overview

The AI Developer will design, develop, and deploy advanced AI-powered applications, Agentic AI systems, and intelligent automation solutions. This role demands strong expertise across the modern AI stack — from LLMs and RAG architectures to LangChain, LangGraph, Vector Databases, MCP integrations, and PyTorch-based model development.




Key Responsibilities

Design and develop AI-powered applications and intelligent automation solutions for healthcare operations.
Build and deploy Agentic AI systems capable of autonomous reasoning, planning, and task execution.
Develop Generative AI applications using Large Language Models (OpenAI, Claude, Llama, and similar platforms).
Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures using Vector Databases.
Develop and optimize AI agents using LangChain and LangGraph frameworks.
Integrate AI solutions with healthcare systems, enterprise applications, APIs, and databases.
Implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations to enable AI agent communication and tool orchestration.
Fine-tune, evaluate, and optimize AI/ML models using PyTorch.
Build scalable prompt engineering and orchestration workflows.
Partner with business stakeholders to identify AI-driven automation opportunities.
Ensure AI governance, security, compliance, monitoring, and responsible AI practices.
Maintain code quality through GitHub, version control, peer reviews, and CI/CD pipelines.
Research emerging AI technologies and recommend innovative solutions.

Enterprise AI in Production




AI Governance Frameworks




Ideal Candidate Profile

Passionate about AI innovation and emerging technologies.
Strong analytical thinking with the ability to design scalable, production-ready AI systems.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills for working with global teams.
Comfortable supporting U.S. healthcare operations during U.S. business hours (2 PM – 11 PM IST).

Why Join Bandi Informatics?

Build cutting-edge Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions with real-world impact.
Direct exposure to large-scale U.S. healthcare transformation initiatives.
Work with modern AI frameworks, cloud platforms, and enterprise tools.
Collaborative, innovation-driven culture with strong career growth opportunities.
Competitive compensation package.



How to Apply

Interested candidates are encouraged to apply through Naukri.com with an updated resume highlighting relevant AI experience, projects, and tech stack. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further rounds.
